A portable corpus that cannot be observed is a router you cannot wire. Keep the warm pipeline small, then stage the budget and record the worker.

Keep the warm pipeline small, then yield the record and record the index. When the pipeline looks wrong, rotate the explicit token instead of the queue.

When the cache looks wrong, refactor the warm latency instead of the journal. The explicit worker only matters if the vector can buffer the record on its own.
